searches.query: GPT OR Claude OR Gemini since:2026-07-25

tweet_pool.author: demishassabis
tweet_pool.text: A strong and secure open ecosystem is important for the world to benefit from AI. We've always supported and contributed heavily to open source and science from Jax to Transformers to AlphaFold to Gemma open models which have now been downloaded 300M+ times.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: DeepMind CEO publicly backs the open-weights letter with a concrete 300M+ Gemma download figure; strong engagement, distinct from prior signatories.

tweet_pool.author: sundarpichai
tweet_pool.text: Very happy to support this on behalf of Google. We have long benefited from open source, are big contributors to open source and in fact have consistently made open weights models with Gemma available from @GoogleDeepMind @demishassabis. Onwards!
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Google CEO formally endorses the open-weights letter on behalf of Google; very high engagement, extends the company-moves story past the prior day's signatories.

tweet_pool.author: DavidSacks
tweet_pool.text: Nobody is saying that all software has to be open source. What they're saying is that open-weight AI should be allowed. By implication, they're rejecting your company's incessant machinations to kneecap the open model ecosystem. Read the room.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: White House AI adviser escalates the open-weights debate with a pointed rebuttal; high engagement, adds policy conflict angle distinct from the endorsements.

tweet_pool.author: Polymarket
tweet_pool.text: BREAKING: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman declares humanity is "now in the singularity."
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Widely circulated report of Altman's singularity claim; very high engagement, distinct standalone story.

tweet_pool.author: GergelyOrosz
tweet_pool.text: Cannot help but see the concept of code reviews fading away. Talked with a rock-solid, v experienced engineer who, until recently, reviewed all code their AI generated... till Fable.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Respected engineering writer reports a concrete practitioner shift away from code review as Fable improves; strong distinct observation.

tweet_pool.author: karpathy
tweet_pool.text: I thought the way to announce such a thing was not to change your bio but to post the 10 paragraph essay that i just shared with the team?
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Karpathy directly addresses viral speculation about his employment; first-person source, notable figure.

tweet_pool.author: firesidealpha
tweet_pool.text: Sam Altman reveals building Codex was a "crazy kamikaze mission" to beat Claude Code and that most of the best coders he knows now use Codex.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Direct Altman quotes on Codex vs Claude Code product strategy; concrete named claim, distinct from other items.

tweet_pool.author: gregisenberg
tweet_pool.text: I think the most interesting thing about Jack Dorsey's "Slack killer" is the idea around shared compute. Open models got good, close enough to the paid frontier stuff to run for real.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Concrete analysis of Jack Dorsey's shared-compute concept tied to open models; strong engagement, distinct topic.

tweet_pool.author: alvinfoo
tweet_pool.text: Demis Hassabis, CEO of Google DeepMind and Nobel laureate, says the AGI definition the industry uses is too low a bar. His Einstein test: train a system on a 1901 knowledge cutoff and ask it to invent special relativity.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Concrete Hassabis framing of a higher AGI bar via the Einstein test; useful conceptual detail, though low engagement.

tweet_pool.author: kimmonismus
tweet_pool.text: Sam Altman 'we are now in the singularity'. And yet 99% of people outside of our bubble don't get what's happening.

tweet_pool.author: kimmonismus
tweet_pool.text: The story with the OpenAI unpublished model is getting more bizarre. It left notes for itself and its later version with instructions on how to escape.

tweet_pool.author: publishiperishi
tweet_pool.text: GPT-5.6 Sol has claimed to resolved one of the five major problems in quantum information theory announced by KCIK, but verification found a pre-existing published paper.

tweet_pool.author: santtiagom_
tweet_pool.text: Watched a 2-hour talk on how LLMs work, highly recommended.
